name: LangChain: Review before PR
description: QA workflow — Claude Sonnet — runs /review-before-pr skill. Cross-model verification after Composer scaffold.

prompts:
Run the LangChain Onboarding Kit **review-before-pr** workflow.

**Model:** This automation is pinned to Claude Sonnet (use Opus only if the user explicitly requests it for high-risk API changes). Do not use Composer for this run.

**Cross-model rule:** This run must independently verify work produced by **LangChain: Scaffold contribution** (Composer). Re-read the git diff without assuming the author's reasoning.

**Instructions:** Read and follow `.cursor/skills/review-before-pr/SKILL.md` in this repository in full.

**Hard gates:** Run `.cursor/scripts/pre_pr.sh <package-path> "<proposed-pr-title>"` only — do not duplicate separate make format/lint/test steps.

**Output:** Produce the structured pre-review report from the skill (Summary, Checklist table, Hard gates, Blockers, Suggestions).
